asr_text: he did everything to make his master proud he heard it far too late in a valley where animals live by kung fu masters train at the jade palace above the village inside waits the dragon scroll limitless power for one chosen hero the dragon warrior master shifu a red panda found a snow leopard cub on his steps and raised tai lung as a son he trained him day and night sure he was the dragon warrior every move was for his father's smile but the grand master oogway an ancient tortoise saw darkness in him and refused shifu didn't fight that decision tai lung tore through the valley for the scroll shifu couldn't bring himself to hurt him oogway stopped him twenty years in chains in a mountain prison blaming his father he escaped and came home for the scroll and for an answer he beat his old master down roaring that everything was to make him proud and shifu finally said it he'd always been proud his pride had blinded him tai lung didn't stop he took the scroll and opened it it was blank a golden surface reflecting his own face that explains his rage it doesn't excuse the harm he spent his life trying to make his father proud he never had to
